title: A larger slow sphere
hook: Change sphere radius and predict drag force.
misconception: drag force stays fixed when sphere radius doubles.
objective: Apply F = 6πηrv to compare drag force when sphere radius changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With creeping flow at fixed speed and fluid viscosity, F = 6πηrv. When sphere radius doubles, drag force becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model F = 6πηrv; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider creeping flow at fixed speed and fluid viscosity, with a nonzero initial result. If sphere radius triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on drag force?
recall.why: Apply F = 6πηrv under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
